requirements.title: CMPLX(X[,KIND]) accepts complex X and optional scalar integer constant KIND
requirements.definition: For the one-argument form with optional KIND, X shall be complex and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression if present.

pending.complex-form-X-complex: Positive plan uses CMPLX((1.25,-2.5)) and observes exact components; a noncomplex X for this specific form is an unnumbered argument restriction and has no diagnostic facet here.
pending.complex-form-KIND-scalar-integer-constan: Positive plan uses CMPLX((1.25,-2.5), KIND=KIND(0.0D0)); KIND(0.0D0) is a scalar integer constant expression naming the double-precision real kind. Check KIND(REAL(result)) == KIND(0.0D0) and exact components 1.25D0 and -2.5D0; invalid KIND forms are source-control only.

requirements.title: CMPLX(X[,Y,KIND]) accepts integer, real, or BOZ X and optional compatible Y and KIND
requirements.definition: For the two-value form, X shall be integer, real, or a BOZ literal; Y, if present, shall be integer, real, or a BOZ literal; KIND, if present, shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.real-form-X-integer-real-or-BOZ: Use conforming references CMPLX(2,0), CMPLX(2.5,0.0), and a nonzero actual BOZ literal CMPLX(B'00000001',0,KIND=KIND(0.0D0)). The BOZ reference is an argument-admission plan: it observes that a BOZ literal is accepted as X and that the call has complex type with selected kind KIND(0.0D0). It does not claim evidence that the BOZ bits were converted into the real-part value; that value has no portable oracle because REAL(boz) interpretation is processor dependent by 16.9.172 p5 case (iii) after 16.3.3 padding or truncation.
pending.real-form-Y-integer-real-or-BOZ: Use conforming references CMPLX(2,-5), CMPLX(1.25,-2.5), and a nonzero actual BOZ literal CMPLX(2,B'00000001',KIND=KIND(0.0D0)). The BOZ reference is an argument-admission plan: it observes that a BOZ literal is accepted as Y and that the call has complex type with selected kind KIND(0.0D0). It does not claim evidence that the BOZ bits were converted into the imaginary-part value; that value has no portable oracle because REAL(boz) interpretation is processor dependent by 16.9.172 p5 case (iii) after 16.3.3 padding or truncation.
pending.real-form-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-e: Use CMPLX(2,-5,KIND=KIND(0.0D0)) and compare KIND of REAL(result) with KIND(0.0D0); invalid KIND forms are source-control only.

requirements.title: CMPLX returns a complex result of the selected or default real kind
requirements.definition: The result is complex; present KIND selects the kind type parameter and absent KIND selects default real kind.

pending.result-complex-type: Assign CMPLX(2,-5) to a complex variable initialized to a distinct value and check exact real and imaginary components.
pending.present-KIND-selects-complex-kind: Check KIND(REAL(CMPLX(2,-5,KIND=KIND(0.0D0)))) == KIND(0.0D0) with exact integer components.
pending.absent-KIND-default-real-kind: Check KIND(REAL(CMPLX(2,-5))) == KIND(0.0) while exact integer components remain 2.0 and -5.0.

requirements.title: CMPLX defaulting and component construction define exact results for exact inputs
requirements.definition: Absent Y is treated as zero, absent KIND is treated as KIND(0.0), complex X is decomposed into REAL and AIMAG, and CMPLX(X,Y,KIND) has real and imaginary parts REAL(X,KIND) and REAL(Y,KIND).

pending.absent-Y-supplies-zero-imaginary-part: Use CMPLX(-3) and expect exact real part -3.0 and imaginary part 0.0; mutate by supplying Y=1 so the imaginary check fails.
pending.absent-KIND-supplies-default-real-kind: For CMPLX(2,-5), check KIND(REAL(result)) == KIND(0.0) while exact components remain 2.0 and -5.0.
pending.complex-X-decomposes-to-parts: Use z=(1.25,-2.5) and expect CMPLX(z) to have exact components 1.25 and -2.5; mutate by swapping component expectations.
pending.components-come-from-REAL-conversions: Use integer inputs CMPLX(2,-5,KIND=KIND(0.0D0)) and expect exactly 2.0D0 and -5.0D0, values exactly representable in the selected kind. For BOZ source forms, use actual nonzero BOZ literals CMPLX(B'00000001',B'00000010',KIND=KIND(0.0D0)) only as an admission/type-kind source plan: observe that BOZ literals are accepted for X and Y and that the result is complex of kind KIND(0.0D0). Do not claim value-conversion coverage for the BOZ real or imaginary component; REAL(boz) bit-sequence interpretation is processor dependent by 16.9.172 p5 case (iii) after 16.3.3 padding or truncation.

requirements.title: CMPLX component conversions inherit REAL approximation latitude for inexact conversions
requirements.definition: Where the REAL conversions named by the result-value rule approximate an inexact or kind-changing value, the exact rounded component value is not fixed by this CMPLX unit.

pending.inexact-REAL-conversion-not-exact-oracle: No portable oracle may require an exact bit pattern, decimal spelling, or numeric equality/inequality for CMPLX components produced through inexact REAL conversion or from BOZ literal bit interpretation. For BOZ, 16.9.172 p5 case (iii) fixes the internal bit sequence for REAL(boz) after 16.3.3 padding or truncation but explicitly makes interpretation processor dependent; therefore a fixture may observe only BOZ-argument admission and the resulting complex type/selected kind, not conversion of the BOZ bits to a portable real or imaginary component value.
